page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highcpu-48 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance featuring 48 vCPUs and 96 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8581C processor with an x86_64 architecture, this server provides 24 physical cores running at 2.3 GHz. The hardware configuration allocates 2.0 GB of memory per core and includes a 260 MB L3 cache. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and has zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results show strong performance in compute-heavy tasks. The instance achieves top-tier performance in Geekbench single-core tests, image processing, and text processing. Multi-threaded operations are also highly capable, with a Passmark CPU score of 60557.12 and a strong Geekbench multi-core score of 17853.0. For data manipulation, bzip3 multi-threaded decompression reaches 285.51 GB/sec, and static web serving throughput is measured at 75.61 GB/sec. LLM inference speeds are strong, processing 3649.93 tokens/sec for 135M model prompts and 200.1 tokens/sec for 7B model prompts.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance offers high resource density for CPU-bound workloads without the added cost of excess memory. It is highly suitable for compute-intensive workloads such as software compilation, image processing, text processing, and web serving. The lack of local storage and GPUs makes it less suitable for large-scale database storage or heavy deep learning training, but it serves as an efficient platform for CPU-based inference, cryptography, and parallel processing tasks.
